note: W34 ratchet (readiness G11), INVERTED POLARITY. Per (early stage, surface): the number of late-stage (7-12) slots carrying one of that stage's seeds. This is REACH, not debt, so it is a FLOOR: a decrease is a hard failure and an increase asks for the floor to be raised. `denominators` freezes the late-slot counts the reach is measured against, because a count that holds while its denominator shrinks is not the same reach. Re-record with --record only after deliberately reseeding the late stages, never to silence a failure. Retired when every early stage reaches the late path on say_now and fluency, not only on drills.
